headline: Africa Launches Energy Bank to Fund Oil and Gas Projects
summary: Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organization established the Africa Energy Bank in Abuja to finance oil and gas projects after Western lenders retreated under climate commitments.
why: Development banks and financial institutions play a critical role in project financing for the energy sector, particularly in capital-intensive oil and gas extraction across emerging markets.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: The establishment of a new specialized bank directly impacts the financing and development of energy projects in the region.
